tagline.en: MiniMax H3 — an Apache-2.0 joint audio-and-video generator that writes a synchronized soundtrack right into the MP4.
tagline.zh: MiniMax H3——Apache-2.0 许可的音视频联合生成模型，把同步的声轨直接写进 MP4。

en: MiniMax H3 is a video generation model from MiniMax that produces audio and video together. Rather than adding sound as a separate step, it jointly generates both, muxing a 32kHz stereo audio track into the output MP4 so picture and sound are synchronized from the start. It's released under Apache-2.0.

The model is a joint audio+video diffusion transformer (DiT) with a coupled rectified-flow denoiser, and it supports three modes: text-to-video-with-audio, a keyframe-conditioned mode from a first/last frame, and a reference-to-video-with-audio mode. It runs as single-GPU PyTorch and targets around 80GB of VRAM.

In WorldFoundry you run MiniMax H3 through the shared pipeline — give it a prompt (plus a keyframe or reference where relevant), and it writes an MP4 with a matched soundtrack. Supply the real H3 weights path at load time.
zh: MiniMax H3 是 MiniMax 推出的视频生成模型，能同时生成音频与视频。它不是把声音作为独立步骤后加，而是联合生成两者，把 32kHz 立体声音轨混流进输出的 MP4，让画面与声音从一开始就同步。该模型采用 Apache-2.0 许可。
模型是一个音视频联合的扩散 transformer（DiT），配合耦合的 rectified-flow 去噪器，支持三种模式：带音频的文生视频、由首/末帧驱动的关键帧模式，以及带音频的参考生视频模式。它以单 GPU PyTorch 运行，目标显存约 80GB。
在 WorldFoundry 中，你通过统一 pipeline 运行 MiniMax H3——给它提示词（必要时再加关键帧或参考），它便输出一段带匹配声轨的 MP4。加载时请提供真实的 H3 权重路径。

whenToUse.en: Reach for MiniMax H3 when you want video with a synchronized soundtrack in one shot — text-to-video, keyframe-driven, or reference-driven — under an open Apache-2.0 license.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想一步得到带同步声轨的视频——文生视频、关键帧驱动或参考驱动——且希望使用开放的 Apache-2.0 许可时，选用 MiniMax H3。

notFor.en: It's demanding on hardware, targeting around 80GB of VRAM. The bundled checkpoint id is a placeholder, so you must supply the real H3 weights path at load.
notFor.zh: 它对硬件要求较高，目标显存约 80GB。随附的 checkpoint id 是占位值，加载时你必须提供真实的 H3 权重路径。

en: 32kHz stereo soundtrack muxed into the output MP4
Three modes: text-to-video, keyframe, and reference-to-video (all with audio)
zh: 32kHz 立体声音轨混流进输出 MP4
三种模式：文生视频、关键帧、参考生视频（均带音频）
单 GPU PyTorch；目标显存约 80GB
